The exact joint MGF r/(r−sum t_i)[1+sum_i w_i t_i/(r(1-w_i)−t_i)] gives the mixed cumulant [(k−1)!/r^k]*(1+(-1)^{k−1} product_i w_i/(1−w_i)); the log expansion uses only distinct linear factors. Product AM–GM bounds odds product by (k−1)^−k; equality k=2 allows any two weights summing to one, k>=3 requires equal within I and N=k. Independently checked all 15 mixed cumulants of one rational 4-weight example from the generator moment recursion and partition formula; odd/even sign distinguished. Strict positivity claims exclude zero-rate/zero-weight boundaries.
